name: Raffles Residences Coconut Grove
statusRemark: Biscayne Bay · First standalone Raffles residences
description: Raffles Residences Coconut Grove is an intimate collection of 35 private homes on Biscayne Bay at 2545 South Bayshore Drive. Developed by Mast Capital and BH Group, it is Raffles' first standalone residential building: no hotel and no overnight guests. Brandon Haw Architecture has designed curved balconies and deep terraces oriented to the bay, the Grove canopy and the Miami skyline. The collection runs from two- to four-bedroom residences, crowned by a limited penthouse offering.
editorialLine: Raffles without a hotel. Thirty-five homes on Biscayne Bay.

amenities.label: Accor Ownership Benefits
amenities.sub: Elite ALL recognition and preferred rates

amenitiesDescription:
Launch materials name a resident restaurant, spa and fitness center, and a rooftop with a pool deck and bar. The limited penthouses are planned with private pools. A complete amenity schedule and floor-by-floor program have not yet been published.

Accor One Living supports the development, design and operation of the residential community. Through Accor Ownership Benefits, owners receive Elite recognition in the ALL Accor loyalty program and preferred rates across the Accor portfolio.
